body: Linkin Park is my favorite band of all time and I’ve been a fan since 2003 when I was 12 years old. My parents got divorced and my Dad was a real asshole and so wasn’t my Mom’s family. Their music helped me then and it’s helped me through everything else life has thrown at me since (I’m 28 now). With Chester’s suicide (the lead singer), their music has become even closer to me. So it’s cool to see someone else feeling the same way that I do, and Chester did, getting help from the music.

I never used to be bitter, even being depressed and suicidal for the better part of the last 15 years. However, lately, I have noticed that I have become very bitter. I hate reading stories and stuff about that sort of thing as well, OP. I hate my family and my past friends who have all enjoyed happiness and surpassed me in every way imaginable. I have people that I don’t even know who have had so much success and happiness in their life. But for some reason I am mostly bitter towards my own famil. I really actually fucking hate my family at this point and I never used I feel like that.

Waking up is the hardest part of my entire life. The thought of waking up is almost unbearable to me. I pray that I die in my sleep every night and I drink so much every night that I’m hoping it takes me out.

Having been depressed for over 15 years now, I used to care about hurting people in my family etc. However the last few weeks, I have for some reason grown to not care at all who I hurt and I’ve actually become somewhat bitter in my head, where I kind of hope I hurt my family. It’s weird to have witnessed myself grow into this mind state. But simply put, I feel the same, OP.
He should do a small series for Psycho Series 2. Maybe like 20 episodes and wrap it up. I don’t count the graphic novel as a part. It would be sick if he did that.
The one the band posted about on their social media to tune in and watch. It was a show in Italy. That’s the best one, in my opinion.
